location: Constructor University, GSA (in Student Activity Centre)
description:
Mystery Ingredient Bake Night
Join the Baking Atelier for a creative bake night inspired by German flavours! We’ll reveal a mystery ingredient from German baking traditions—perhaps Apfelmus, Marzipan or Quark —and you’ll decide how to use it.
Choose to make cookies, muffins or cupcakes, then add your own twist. You’re welcome to bring flavours from home or try a new fusion and share the story behind your creation. No baking experience needed!

title: AWS Certfications
description: Join us for an engaging session dedicated to everything you need to know about Amazon Web Services (AWS) Certifications! Whether you are completely new to cloud computing or looking to advance your tech career, this event will break down the value of AWS certifications, the various learning paths available, from foundational to professional levels, and how earning them can boost your resume and open doors to high-paying industry roles. title: Internship Workshop
description:
Wondering how to find an internship, what to expect, or where to even begin? Join The Global Review (TGR) for an informal and interactive Internship Experience-Sharing Session, bringing together students from different majors who have already completed their internships. Hear firsthand experiences from fellow students as they share where they interned, how they found their opportunities, what their roles involved, and the challenges and lessons they encountered along the way. From navigating applications and interviews to making the most of your internship, discover practical tips, tricks, and advice to help you prepare for your own journey.
The session will also feature an open Q&A, giving you the opportunity to ask questions, exchange ideas, and get honest insights directly from students who have been through the process. Whether you're a first-year student just starting to explore opportunities or a second-year student preparing for your mandatory internship, this session is for you!

Open to: Students from ALL MAJORS
Real experiences, practical advice, and everything you wish you knew before your internship!
